components.css: .ds-card{font-family:var(--body,"Manrope",sans-serif);max-width:420px;border-radius:12px;padding:22px;background:var(--paper-2,#211e1b);color:var(--white,#faf7f2)}.ds-title{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;margin-bottom:10px}.ds-title span{color:var(--gold,#edb65c);font:700 16px/1 var(--display,"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif)}.ds-title h3{margin:0;font:700 26px/1.12 var(--display,"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif)}.ds-card p{margin:0;color:var(--muted,#bbb3aa);font-size:13px;line-height:1.7}.ds-foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding-top:24px}.ds-foot strong{color:var(--gold,#edb65c);font-size:19px;font-weight:800;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-foot button{font-family:var(--body,"Manrope",sans-serif);min-height:44px;padding:10px 14px;border:1px solid #705139;border-radius:8px;background:#3c2b20;color:var(--gold,#edb65c);font-size:12px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s}.ds-foot button:hover{background:var(--gold,#edb65c);color:var(--ink,#12100f)}.ds-foot button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #f0b83d;outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview:
This name describes the implemented direction; it is not an additional user-approved concept. Warm dark surfaces, generous food photography and direct gold actions present Hà Nội Quán. Burgundy anchors the closing order region. The retained restaurant logo carries the existing identity.

Text and navigation are restrained, while dish names use a compact condensed face. Tonal section changes connect browsing, restaurant information and checkout. This record was extracted from the final CSS cascade, HTML and menu renderer after a code-led refinement. Earlier light stylesheet declarations are superseded.
keyCharacteristics: Warm charcoal backgrounds with slightly lighter containers.
Gold for actions, prices and selection; burgundy for supporting regions.
Manrope reading and headlines paired with Barlow Condensed dish headings.
Rounded photo surfaces, native controls and visible keyboard focus.
Dish photographs and explicit serving suggestions take priority over decoration.

rules.name: Action Gold
rules.body: Use gold consistently for ordering, prices and selected states; keep long descriptive text neutral.

rules.name: Two Voices
rules.body: Use Manrope for reading and broad statements, and Barlow Condensed for dish identity and compact menu headings.

rules.name: Tonal Surface
rules.body: Separate resting content through charcoal tone and spacing; reserve broad shadows for overlays and scrolled navigation.

dos: **Do** preserve the original logo and Vietnamese diacritics.
**Do** connect page sections and checkout with warm charcoal tones.
**Do** pair gold actions and prices with neutral descriptive text.
**Do** frame Asian dishes around the complete serving and use full 4:3 sushi photographs with integrated accompaniments.
**Do** retain serving-suggestion copy and raster provenance.
**Do** keep focus visible, controls comfortably tappable and reduced motion supported.
donts: **Don't** infer the current palette from superseded light stylesheet declarations.
**Don't** turn catalog images into cropped decorative backgrounds.
**Don't** replace the original logo with a generated identity.
**Don't** add decorative gold frames throughout the interface.
**Don't** hide essential menu content behind entrance animations.
